facts.text: Abafar was a remote desert planet located within the Outer Rim Territories, and was host to massive amounts of rhydonium, a scarce and volatile fuel source.

evidence.quote: Abafar was a remote desert planet located within the Outer Rim Territories, and was host to massive amounts of rhydonium, a scarce and volatile fuel source.

facts.text: The large desert was known as the Void, and light was twisted in a way by the strange regolith that made it impossible to see tracks because there were no shadows.

evidence.quote: The large desert was known as the Void, and light was twisted in a way by the strange regolith that made it impossible to see tracks because there were no shadows.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems set up a mining installation in the settlement of Pons Ora.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems set up a mining installation in the settlement of Pons Ora.

facts.text: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure had a drilling platform on Abafar to mine rhydonium.

evidence.quote: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure had a drilling platform on Abafar to mine rhydonium.

facts.text: Following the Battle of Endor, the New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles visited Abafar whilst looking for Imperial forces that may have been hiding in the Outer Rim.

evidence.quote: Following the Battle of Endor, the New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles visited Abafar whilst looking for Imperial forces that may have been hiding in the Outer Rim.

facts.text: Its primary terrain was a desert known as the Void due to properties of the planet's atmosphere and surface regolith that made it impossible to see the sun or any tracks left on the ground, making it extremely easy to get lost amongst the barren flats.

evidence.quote: Its primary terrain was a desert known as the Void due to properties of the planet's atmosphere and surface regolith that made it impossible to see the sun or any tracks left on the ground, making it extremely easy to get lost amongst the barren flats.

facts.text: Known fauna included the Void striders, reptavian creatures that traversed the Void in search of surface water.

evidence.quote: Known fauna included the Void striders, reptavian creatures that traversed the Void in search of surface water.

facts.text: After the Battle of Sarrish, a devastating loss for the Galactic Republic, one of the survivors of the battle, clone commando Captain Gregor, crash-landed on Abafar near the town of Pons Ora, but was left amnesiac with no memory of anything but his name.

evidence.quote: After the Battle of Sarrish, a devastating loss for the Galactic Republic, one of the survivors of the battle, clone commando Captain Gregor, crash-landed on Abafar near the town of Pons Ora, but was left amnesiac with no memory of anything but his name.

facts.text: By 20 BBY, forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems came to Abafar and took over Pons Ora to mine rhydonium for a plot to bomb the Republic strategy conference at Carida.

evidence.quote: By 20 BBY, forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems came to Abafar and took over Pons Ora to mine rhydonium for a plot to bomb the Republic strategy conference at Carida.

facts.text: Thus, while Abafar as a whole was unaligned, the Confederacy maintained a presence on the planet.

evidence.quote: Thus, while Abafar as a whole was unaligned, the Confederacy maintained a presence on the planet.

facts.text: Eventually, the D-Squad, a Republic force of droids led by the Zilkin Colonel Meebur Gascon, crash-landed on the planet after having run into a comet swarm on their way back from stealing a Separatist encryption module.
entities: Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module

facts.text: The 2015 Dorling Kindersley reference book Ultimate Star Wars originally placed Abafar within the Sprizen sector, however, the 2024 Dorling Kindersley reference book Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy moved Abafar to the Quelii sector.
entities: Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy

evidence.quote: The 2015 Dorling Kindersley reference book Ultimate Star Wars originally placed Abafar within the Sprizen sector, however, the 2024 Dorling Kindersley reference book Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy moved Abafar to the Quelii sector.

facts.text: The change was further supported by "Star Systems of the Galaxy," a canon appendix published alongside the Star Wars Galaxy Map on StarWars.com on June 24, 2025.

evidence.quote: The change was further supported by "Star Systems of the Galaxy," a canon appendix published alongside the Star Wars Galaxy Map on StarWars.com on June 24, 2025.

facts.text: Jason Fry—an author who contributed on the appendix—stated that there were no plans of changing Abafar's current placement when asked.
